title: Kanneelle Khayamani – Tinnu Thereesh Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఇంకెంత కాలం ఈ బ్రతుకని – భీతితో ఉన్నావా?
నీ కన్నీళ్ళన్నీ కవిలలో దాచి – శ్రమలలో నీ తోడై ఉండి
ఊహకు మించిన కార్యములన్నీ – నా యేసు చేయును
english: Nee kanneellanni buddilo dhaachi shramalalone thodaiyundi
Oohaku minchina kaaryamulanni naa Yesu cheyunu
Cheyi viduvani Immaanuyelu nee sameepamu nundagaa
Bheethi chendhakumu bhaaramu kaligi praarthana cheyumu
Yobu jeevithaanni marichithivaa.. nireekshana kaligi undumu
translation: Are you living in fear, thinking that only tears are certain,
And that trials are your only companions in this life?
My Jesus collects all your tears and stays with you through your struggles.
He will perform wonders beyond your imagination.
Just believe… keep your hope alive,
And your life will take a turn for the better.
While the faithful God who gives peace is with you,
And Emmanuel, who never lets go of your hand, is near,
Do not be afraid; pray with a burdened heart.
Stop hesitating and start offering praises.
Even if you lose everything and those you trust leave you,
Have you forgotten the life of Job? Keep your hope alive.
intro: Kanneelle Khayamani is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Tinnu Thereesh and music composed by Sudhakar Rella. This song was released on September 14, 2025, through Tinnu Thereesh YouTube Channel.
